description: Replace the content of an existing drop — HTML, or a base64 .zip once the app has GRADUATED to tier 4 (ADR-0182). The URL never changes (origin contract): visitors' browser data survives the update. A drop keeps its type: .zip sites are replaced by a .zip, single-file drops by HTML. If other apps call this one under a contract (dropyour_link), the new version is checked against it before it stays live: a version that breaks one is refused and the previous one put back (error consumer_contract_broken). With an account token, owned drops need no managementToken.

html.description: The new complete HTML content (single-file drops)

managementToken.description: The token returned by dropyour_publish — optional for drops owned by your account token

zipBase64.description: The new .zip archive, base64-encoded — graduated apps only (tier 4)

name: dropyour_replace
title: Replace a drop's content
